3.4.49-50 illa ... iuventus split and noted; 3.4.61 lavit as present (lavere); 3.4.66-67 vim temperatam object set after its subject in-line, idem as nominative plural, viris = 'forces'; 3.4.75-76 ignis subject and Aetnen object made explicit; 3.4.77 postponed nec noted; 3.4.79-80 trecentae ... catenae subject, Pirithoum object, noted.
3.5.6-8 hostium ... socerorum kept across lines; 3.5.15-16 trahentis (Shorey) genitive with Reguli, trahenti noted, veniens taken with aevum; 3.5.24 and 34 Mars as war, noted; 3.5.42 capitis minor as loss of civil status; 3.5.45-46 consilio ... numquam alias dato kept split, noted.
